SUMMARY-
Total dosage: ~3.55g ground P. harmala (2.8g gel caps @T-25, 1/4tsp/~.75g lime/water shot) + 1 Psilocybin chocolate square (~1g).
Time: ~4hr total
T+0:15-T+0:30 First effects noticed
T+1:30-2:00 Reaching peak
T+3:30-4:00 Plateau
T+4:15-4:45 Come down
OUTLINE-
T-0:25
23:35 Ingested 4 Double O veggie gel caps of P. harmala aka Syrian Rue aka Peggy Harm. Aprox 2.8g - feeling excited with my wife.
T/0:00
12:00 Ingested 1/4 tsp ground P. harmala in water & lime juice followed by 1 Psilocybin chocolate square - with my wife.
T+00:30-01:00
01:00 First noticeable effects. Dryness of eyes & mouth. Started aprox 30min ago. Currently having vivid imagination, slurred thoughts, strange body feelings. I am hungry. Have not eaten much today. - watching Moving Art: Oceans with my wife.
T+02:15-03:00 - Posted @ 4:18
@ aprox 2:45 am. Drunk off my ass. Tracers have been visible in light for last hour or so. Hard to tell time. No real CEV but closing my eyes is a trip through another reality. - listening to Chill-out music with my wife.
T+03:30-04:00 - Posted @ 11:19
NOTE: This time is a complete guess
@aprox 4:15am. Notice first indication of coming down. Effects are still potent, but ever so slightly less. Feel more a direction of decline instead of increase in the psychoactive experience. - with my wife.
T+4:00-04:30 - Posted @ 4:19
Sober or nearly there. Very gentle ride overall. Wife is asleep - feeling tired with my wife.
REVIEW-
The trip itself was a very interesting experience. Visuals were very light the entire ride through, but mind space was augmented considerably. The dosage of Psilocybin was significantly low, only a half dose each, that we were not overwhelmed with visuals or loss of rationality, however it was potentiated by the Harmaline to the point of very visceral and sensual physical effects. The world felt as vibration, sounds echoed around us in some metaphysical background, coming through the next reality over and seeping through our apartment walls to mingle with the music from our TV.
There were no CEVs to speak of, however closing our eyes was an immediate escape into a parallel dimension inhabited by various personas and feelings. Existing as thought and vibration while discussing with numerous other personalities or sitting back and observing them. My wife spoke of seeing Grecian Deities specifically, statuesque and some colorful. She spoke most often of hearing voices and we both emphasized the physical effects we felt. Opening our eyes again brought us immediately back to the physical reality we were inhabiting, however our mental and physical sensations never deviated, save for the wax and wane of the chemical waves in our system.
I took two trips to the bathroom. Once to defecate and again to apply some ointment to a small scratch on the back of my hand that had started burning as only surface scrapes can. The ointment immediately soothed my pain and allowed me to focus on the experience we were partaking in. Turning on the bathroom light revealed very minor open eyed visuals to me. I would see tracers outlining my body or flashing in my peripheral vision. At one point, I thought it was dog hairs clinging to my clothes. At least one was, but the rest persisted after I removed the follicle. My wife spoke of seeing the pin up girls who decorate our walls moving, but only mentioned it once around our peak experience.
There was little to no nausea to speak of. We had eaten very little throughout the day. Even whilst tripping we were able to lightly snack on tortilla chips and some peanut butter and jelly sandwiches that my wife had prepared before hand. Preparatory work was an important part of this experience. My wife laid out a Tarot reading, which I will outline below, and I pulled a quick I Ching reading of my own. This helped focus our intent and the trip itself as a result. My I Ching also guided me in adjusting our dosage at the last minute so that we would have a full experience while avoiding the nausea, cramping, vomiting and diarrhea that are so prevalent with Harmaline, particularly when ingesting plant material like Syrian Rue. The use of gel capsules as a primary delivery method was also a very effective solution. It strikes me quite clearly how I had previously overdosed the Harmaline using up to 7g instead current 3.55g. Additionally, the previous use of a citric acid extract enhances the nausea and emetic effects as the stomach turns sour. I will be exploring the use of gel capsules for ingesting Mescaline at my next opportunity.
